summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting that on September 16, 2026 the Florida Office of Financial Regulation granted a Final Order of Approval to subsidiary Banco de Credito del Peru for acquisition of 100% of shares and control of Helm Bank USA. The buyer is Orange Per Holding S.A./Orange Financial Holding Inc., special-purpose vehicles. Completion remains subject to Federal Reserve approval and customary closing conditions; no price, premium, or outside date disclosed. Prior updates were furnished December 29, 2025 and May 5, 2026. Watch the Fed approval timing as the remaining gating item.
